create_files_dataset: create a FilesDataset from a directory root with a benchmark file suffix filter
iterate_benchmark_uris: iterate over all benchmark URIs in a FilesDataset with optional memoization
get_dataset_size: get the total number of benchmark files in a FilesDataset directory tree
load_benchmark_from_uri: load a Benchmark from a parsed BenchmarkUri path in a FilesDataset
select_random_benchmark: select a random benchmark from a FilesDataset using a numpy random generator
